notes.title: 🔥 Puzzles & Pyrologics update is live!
notes.notes:
[p]Ahoy, Sky Sailors! [/p][p][b]We’re delighted to announce that the Puzzles & Pyrologics update is now live![/b] [/p][p]At the heart of this update lies the new puzzle system, which lets you take your endless creativity to new heights. There’s a new resource, logic system, building pieces, upgrades, combat improvements, animations, and much more.  [/p][p]Several of these new features and improvements are based on your feedback, and we thank you all for making your voices heard! [/p][p]As the Steam Summer Sale goes live later today, [b]Aloft will be 20% off until July 10[/b], so tell your friends and grow your own dream sky-village. [/p][p]Watch the Launch Trailer and soar smoothly into the new update: [/p][previewyoutube="OA0IV8M-d80;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Get an overview of the new features below. Our team is already getting a head start on the next update, so keep on reading until the end to find out what's on the horizon! 
 [/p][h2][b]🧩 Puzzles & Pyrologics 🔥[/b] [/h2][p]Using the new Emberstone resource, you can now build and power your own trapdoors, rotating walls, pressure plates, levers, timed triggers, and all sorts of clever contraptions. Mining Emberstone is a bit more involved than simply bashing it with a pickaxe. You’ll first need to break the exterior shell to uncover its red-hot core, then cool it with water to further mine and gather it. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/c4e95ba99a57de926a5eaf5a48c09af60e9e60aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This new resource can be used to power the Pyrologics system, which is how you design your own puzzles. Connect a resonator to a windmill to generate a field in which the new pieces can be placed, such as a pressure plate. The specific interactions and results you want can easily be tailored on the Pyrologic board (think of it like a circuit board). [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/87cbf48adc6030d238cd78272b50b79e00fd4053.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ready-made puzzles can now also be found out in the world. Solve these ancient riddles to earn various rewards. Perhaps they’ll even serve as inspiration for your own puzzles! 
 
 [/p][h2][b]☁️ ️New Wonder Islands ☁️[/b] [/h2][p]Uncover lost secrets on new Wonder Islands filled with puzzles to solve. Unlike the one-off puzzles you’ll find scattered across the skies, these are larger hand-crafted islands containing interlocking challenges, a story to tell, and Pyrologic pieces to sketch. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e0ce0c69d426d92ba03c494ff26b9375f3a0b665.jpg"][/img] [/p][h2][b]⚔️ Combat Improvements ⚔️[/b] [/h2][p]Difficulty scaling is now based on the area of the map, rather than on how many islands you’ve cleansed, which should provide a smoother experience. We’ve also made improvements to balancing, visual feedback, and animations, both for enemies and for players (leap, block). And if you’d like a more peaceful experience, or a harsher challenge, check out our new difficulty settings, now found in the options menu. (Yes, peaceful mode is now [i]truly [/i]peaceful!) [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]🛠️ Building Pieces & Decorations 🛠️[/b] [/h2][p]In addition to the Pyrologic building pieces, we’ve added Emberstone lamps to brighten up your contraptions! This update also brings a variety of other new building pieces and upgrades, such as the new vertical windmill, designed to catch wind from any direction! There’s also the much-requested custom stretchable rope and various equilateral triangle building pieces.  
 
 [/p][h2][b]🤝 Player Contest Islands 🤝[/b] [/h2][p]The results of the Island Creator Contest we held on Discord were incredible, and we’re including some of the best ones in this update! These islands will appear seamlessly in the sky like any other. Explore them to uncover their unique stories and reap hidden rewards waiting to be discovered. 
 
 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fc9e07024ac05d07c182d6bcd329f19fe3a0ab74.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/526472884483260785"]full Changelog[/url] for a more detailed list of changes. [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]🔭 What’s on the Horizon 🔭[/b] [/h2][p]Peek through the spyglass for a glimpse at what we’re working on:  [/p][list][*][p]New world generation, an improved system that will set the foundation for future updates [/p][/*][*][p]Sailing upgrades and wind lanes [/p][/*][*][p]Progression system revamp [/p][/*][*][p]Life trees tied to ecosystem restoration [/p][/*][*][p]New enemy and corruption tiers [/p][/*][*][p]New tools and weapons [/p][/*][*][p]New decoration options [/p][/*][*][p]Reward system and character customisation [/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t wait to share more about these features soon!  [/p][p]Aloft will be 20% off as part of the Steam Summer Sale, going live later today and ending on July 10. Soar the skies with your friends this summer.    [/p][p]See you in the clouds! 🌥️ [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/954b2f796ab6f3c15a94ea17327770cd4f1f896b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Puzzles & Pyrologics Update Announced at the Best Indie Games Showcase!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Sky Sailors!  

We’ve just revealed our next major update [b]Puzzles & Pyrologics[/b] at the [b]Best Indie Games Summer Showcase[/b], and it’s coming to [b]Aloft [/b]on [b]June 26[/b]!  

This update introduces an all-new [b]puzzle system[/b] that lets you connect interactive building pieces to power up your creations. Think rotating walls, trapdoors, and more, all linked together by clever circuitry design.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/be0cb3a3b1ab072040a368f4a8ec3ab367035c92.gif[/img]

At the heart of this system is a brand-new resource: [b]Emberstone[/b], which harnesses the power of [b]heat-based energy[/b] to bring your contraptions to life.  

Thanks to these new features, you will now come across puzzles on different islands, such as small trials on points of interest, and bigger, more complex challenges on new Wonder Islands! 

We’re also making some improvements to combat by refining the experience to better match the evolving world of Aloft.  

Get ready to build smarter, fight sharper, and explore new layers of creativity in the skies. 🧩⚔️

notes.title: The Critters & Wonders Update is Here! 🦋
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Sky Sailors!  

Our first major update is now available!  

Say hello to your new best friends in the sky – Critters! In today’s update, the world of Aloft welcomes new life. Take a look at our video showcase below: 

[previewyoutube=3XXkDLq46eU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Collect all the critters! 🦇🐸 [/h2]

Starting today, critters can be found scattered across the world of Aloft. Bees, butterflies, bats, frogs, lizards – you name it. Pick them up to look at their beauty up-close! These little fellas are key to a healthy ecosystem, and that’s where you come in.  

Catch them (carefully!) on any island using the net or lure them with feed in order to bring them with you on your journey across the sky. Wherever they live, the ecosystem benefits so make sure to introduce them to new environments – the more, the merrier! You can even spoil critters by building fancy vivariums for them on your home base.  

Players can also build landing pads to ensure animals land safely after sending them home. Additionally, animal bells can be placed to call all or a specific group of animals back to their pen or enclosure – perfect for shear or meal time! 

Critters come in all shapes, colours, and rarities – so be on the lookout for unique and uncommon patterns! 
 
[h2]Wonder Islands 💭  [/h2]

During your travels, you may now come across a new kind of island in the sky, called Wonder Islands. These islands are fixed in the world and always offer a unique reward or discovery. 

In today’s update, we’ve added two Wonder Islands. Explore them to uncover mysterious ruins, rare treasure, and other secrets. We look forward to adding more of these diverse islands in the future, filling the sky with unique experiences. 

[h2]Shared Homes 🤝  [/h2]

After listening to community feedback, we've decided to offer players an easier way to collaborate together on a single island. Now, when placing a Home Kite, you can choose to create either a Personal Home or a Shared Home. Shared Homes allow all players in a multiplayer session to cooperate, build, and teleport to their Shared Home without requiring permissions. 
 
Shared Homes are world-bound, so they cannot be spawned in/out (for now). If you’d like to revert a Shared Home back to a Personal Home later, you can do that too.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/190bbb968f7073fa7d43e50dd2596f20f9e1cd3d.jpg[/img]
 
For the full list of changes, including a number of quality-of-life, server, and performance improvements, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/525336841073723439]you can check out the changelog here[/url]. We want to express our gratitude to all of you for your support and for playing Aloft. We’re always listening to your feedback, and can’t wait to share more of what we have in store!  

As always, if you come across a bug (of the technical variety), don’t hesitate to report it and we’ll jump on it like a critter with a treat. 

And as a last surprise: starting on March 13th, Aloft will be part of the Steam Spring Sale, making it the perfect time to invite your friends, build your dream skyship, and explore the skies – at a discount! 

See you in the clouds! 🌥️

notes.title: March Update - Devlog #11
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! 
[/b]
We hope you are doing well! On our side, everything is good and we’ve been busy!

As you may know, we just finished a big marketing period with the release of an update to our demo and a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=whKrlataNSY]new trailer[/url]. Of course, the biggest news of all still is the Early Access release date: [b]Early 2024.[/b]
If you didn’t read [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/]our last devlog[/url], you should! A lot of nice things happened for us in the beginning of the year! 

[h3]So, what’s new? [/h3]
First, we welcomed two new talents in our growing team:[url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7033839122024681472] Simon [/url]as our second developer, he will focus on[b] multiplayer development[/b] and [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7036407331424727040]Anthony[/url] as our 3D Environment Artist Intern. Anthony’s work really shines and his textures are simply gorgeous!

Then, we are now on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@astrolabeinteractive]Tik Tok [/url]&[url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/YR7zOJFk6eU] Youtube short[/url]. We’re going to try to post regularly but be patient with us, we’re just getting started :) Don't hesitate to like and follow for more Aloft shorts!

The Photo Contest is over and let me tell you, we have some [url=https://discord.gg/XA8KkzYY]very creative talents in our community[/url]. It was a real blast to look through all the pictures, but judging them was tough! We’re going to do a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@astrolabeinteractive]Tik Tok[/url] recap with the pictures so stay tuned! 

In the meantime, here are the winners in the 4 categories : 

[h3]Best Base:[/h3] Yutapo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/4193e741c7fbeb754bb4796f9569f69e883d80c6.png[/img]

[h3]Best Photo : [/h3] OrchideeFan944
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/6ab21501a85475aa2c147ab93a02801efe03f0b2.png[/img]

[h3]Best Tiny House : [/h3] Professor Muddles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/2accb8c64e53ff85f13c184b9abbbfa50e0965ef.png[/img]

[h3]Most Creative : [/h3] Yonack Dreven
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/875ce2e0c464c6b61b71005191088dedb3566f97.png[/img]


While the Photo Contest might be over, our community members are sharing [url=https://discord.gg/XA8KkzYY]stunning screenshots of what they are creating on Discord.[/url] Please feel free to do the same :) 

To fit the short format of Youtube, we did a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NQwZeBt2HnM]short version of the trailer[/url]. Let us know what you think about our huge leviathan in the comments ;) 

The last, and most recent, piece of news is amazing: [b]we were lucky enough[url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1629457180167380994?s=20] to win the Ubisoft Indie Serie grand prize[/url]! [/b]In addition to the prize money, we will receive support from Ubisoft, something truly invaluable. We’re really happy to share this night with [url=https://www.luciddreamsstudio.com/]Lucid Dream Studio[/url], who won the second prize, offered by the[url=https://www.bnc.ca/] National Bank of Canada[/url]. You should check out their newest project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430220/BIOMORPH/]Biomorph[/url], it’s really cool!
What a day to be part of the Indie community! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/cac138c4c4b67436e70f3dbbeb8246c1491e00b6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Now, what are we working on?[/h3]
 
As you may know, some islands in the game are corrupted by dangerous fungi. This corruption won’t only attack the players, it’ll target the animals as well! Jeremy, our VFX artist, is currently working on the creeping effects of this corruption on the creatures. For the occasion, we wanted to share with you the artistic evolution of the sheep. The wool can look a bit thin at the moment, but it’ll grow over time in the game to be super fluffy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/4ac8039aea9715f914d99c067bbf3baee9c06832.png[/img]

Corruption, animals and corrupted animals aside, our team is moving forward on a lot of projects: 

[h3]Concept Art - Kenzie [/h3]
Kenzie has been working on the alchemy concept for the last weeks.
You already know that, in the game, you can build a base, fly your own island, grow your own veggies… A new, cool, feature will allow you to develop your alchemy skills! 
We can’t spoil everything yet because there is so much new cool stuff coming, but here is the concept art for the terrarium! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/7d27228287893fc4d92b74e0710dd43c21cd3be1.jpg[/img]

[h3]3D art - Mary Jane [/h3]
We were waiting for these for a while now! 
Though that’s the case in the current version of the demo, inventory will not be infinite in Aloft. Fortunately, you will be able to decorate your home and organize your inventory with the new chests. 
Nico, our game designer, showed them in exclusivity during a Twitch Stream. He is live most[url=https://www.twitch.tv/nico_astrolabe] Fridays at 3 pm EST[/url]. Join us! It’s fun to chat with you live and share exclusive stuff. The [url=https://discord.gg/XA8KkzYY]Discord server[/url] is by far the best way to know if a stream is coming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/5af38e9e887b39b7d42b578bbfc36963b761434d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Character customisation - Calvin[/h3]
Character customization is a feature that many of you requested and so Calvin modeled all the different faces in 3D. The final system will have a lot more options such as body types, skin colors, hairstyles and much more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/2cd694c6aeb3ce95576a81559f5ffd35fe7f2d67.png[/img]

[h3]Animal animations - Emma [/h3]
Emma is currently animating the upcoming animals.
Every Thursday, we do a review session internally and everybody shows what they are up to. Emma’s presentations have been SO cute and this is one of the reasons:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/571cdbec2c54dc0b8fca2a6240d1e2c067001090.gif[/img]

[h3]VFX - Jeremy [/h3]
We’re so thrilled to see the VFX coming to life with Jeremy's work! 
The team is growing, every week we can see the game getting better and better. It’s a really rewarding feeling. One of the first VFX that Jeremy worked on is the Fungi fighting effect! It is still a work in progress but we can promise that the combination of sounds and VFX will have an impact. We will show it to you soon.

[h3]Sound Design - Kyle [/h3]
It's so exciting to share Kyle's work for the first time. Sound adds something so special, so relaxing to the game, we think it fits the environment incredibly well, but we will let you be the judge of that. Tell us what you think!
[previewyoutube=hsw8gb8VYvg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
As we announced in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/]the previous devlog[/url] and in our trailer, we’re aiming for an Early Access release at the beginning of 2024.
Manuel, our CEO, and Felix, our Producer, will be at GDC to meet with the professionals of the gaming community. 
Are you going too? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/UTwuSHTp]Discord[/url] to let us know!
2023 will be mostly about development and growing our community but we’ll give you details when the time will come.

Cheers travelers 💫

[url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fe369ad9311194f5ff3e309e754e577f03385ff8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The base building update - Devlog #10
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,[/h2]

Hello everyone! 

Happy new year from everyone at the Astrolabe Interactive studio! We really hope your holidays were restful and that you could spend time with your loved ones during that period or since then. We took some time off to take a breather and prepare ourselves for what is going to be our biggest and most intense year ever! 

We started the new year strong with a new team member; Jeremy is our VFX and technical artist, responsible for all the shader and VFX work in the game. He just got here, so be kind to him, he has a lot of work on his plate! We are 12 people now, almost a full team. 

[h2]New demo update[/h2]

Now for the big, important, amazing part. There’s a new demo update, and it’s coming out today! If that comes as a shock to you, it’s because you’re not on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]Discord server[/url] or following us on [url=https://linktr.ee/aloftgame]social media[/url], because we’ve been talking about this for a while now! We decided to launch it at the start of the Steam Base Building Fest to celebrate all the awesome creative energy our fans have been putting in Aloft. 

So the demo is getting an update, all the things mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3631620304673118730?l=english]last devlog[/url] will be there, of course, and much more, but that’ll be in the last section of this Devlog. 

Another HUGE and AMAZING news is that we have a new trailer out! You just need to go on the FRONT PAGE OF IGN to watch it! We’re honestly amazed that IGN decided to showcase our game, it’s such amazing news! We really hope that this coverage will help Aloft get a lot of visibility, wishlists and new Discord community members. 

[previewyoutube=omcvQIQKmGw;full][/previewyoutube]

Furthermore, we’re also flabbergasted at the new video the youtuber Real Civil Engineer cooked up for us. He takes the time to present the game for new players, but also tries and break the limits of the demo in his own unique brand of humorous creativity. You should really take a look at it, it’s well worth the time to watch it. 

[previewyoutube=xACDyBwdreA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Photo contest[/h2]
One of the new features included in the demo is the Photo mode! Our programmer decided to make it during his holiday break, because he’s just that great. There are still some things to polish, but we’ve been taking just the prettiest photos and screenshots out of it! One thing we learned in the last couple months is that our community is creative like no others and that’s just the best. To encourage that creativity, we organized a photo contest for you to participate in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/f7152664d2a3dd0811f86a8ffcd9834880791a11.gif[/img]

The rules are simple: there are 4 categories to participate in and you can submit one photo per category. If you are picked for the best photo in your category, you get a (secret) prize! The categories are:
[list]
[*] Best base (it is the Base building Fest after all)
[*] Best photo overall
[*] Best Tiny House (because it’s cute)
[*] Most creative construction
[/list]
To participate, simply use this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4w00CmGAUBuPJxA9hjKNpeOsJboUj5P-pbPhwgKqq46Enkg/viewform]Google form[/url] and drop your screenshots! There are more rules and information needed in the form, so make sure you read everything. 

Of course, any kind of inappropriate content will result in an immediate disqualification. Stay wholesome folks!

[h2]What has changed since last time?[/h2]

All the stuff in the last devlog is going to be in the game, but there’s more too! Since he got onboard with the team, our composer/SFX has been hard at work implementing sound effects to the game. They are still unfinished but at least there’s sound in the game now! The infamous sound bug that plagued many of you has received a temporary patch. We are confident that it should fix the bug, but if it still happens, please let us know in the discord channel #feedback-bugs. 

We have some VFX added to the game as well, all that Jeremy has had time to work on in his few weeks with us. It’s not much yet, but it absolutely helps the game feel more alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/0766da54aca9878fad83173a2bde0a759319b4fa.png[/img]

Character and monster animations are mostly done! Some might need a little rework, but otherwise they are complete! We’re really happy to see the game come alive with assets, animations and effects made in-house. It absolutely makes all the difference to the visual experience.  

For a more comprehensive list of changes, please consult the changelog [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3651890488926875862]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/eb8a58ee130ac7e317b836b0695c6fcabd0bf2c8.png[/img]

[h2]Private playtest[/h2]
Finally, we had a private playtest last December and our testers had a great time and were super professional and useful! Our deepest thanks to all who participated in the playtest! Thanks to them, we revised the gliding controls and added a cookbook to remember all your recipes! For anyone who hasn’t been able to participate, there will be more and the best way to know about them is to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]Discord server[/url]!

[h2]Friends of Aloft[/h2]
We always like to share our time in the spotlight with friends! If you want to flex your science brain-muscles, look no further than [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1510440/view/3668778987525688684]Honeycomb[/url], where you can bioengineer the flora and fauna of a whole planet!

We also encourage everyone to take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071430/Roots_of_Yggdrasil/]Roots of Yggdrasil[/url]! It's a viking city-builder currently in development by our friends at [url=https://www.manavoid.com/en/]Manavoid Entertainment[/url]. They have a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wearemanavoid/roots-of-yggdrasil-a-post-ragnarok-roguelike-city-builder]kickstarter [/url]coming soon, so keep your eyes peeled for that!

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
2023 will be a big year for us, actually the biggest so far! We have a bunch of new team members in every discipline quickly ramping up to peak efficiency, and we need them! We’re aiming for an Early Access release at the beginning of 2024, which means that we need to get to work and make an amazing game for everyone to enjoy!

For now, we’ll let everyone enjoy the Aloft demo during the Base Builder Fest and the Games from Quebec Fest over the next two weeks. We are absolutely looking forward to seeing all your beautiful creations in the Photo Contest!

In the meantime, thank you all for reading and stay wholesome!

notes.title: The winter update - Devlog #9
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,[/h2]


Hello everyone! We are so happy to see you again!

Winter settles comfortably in Montreal and you can feel that the holidays are around the corner. 
The streets are lit up, cheerful music is playing and the Christmas markets are in place, along with the city's ice rinks! 
This is the perfect season to stay cozy near a warm fireplace right? This is exactly what we did the last couple of weeks so we don’t really have anything to share…
 
Just kidding! We have SO many news for you! 
 
First, since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/]the last update[/url], our team has grown considerably. We are fortunate to welcome 5 new members : 
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6984167411474128896/]Solene[/url] : our Project Marketing Manager
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6985609987997761536/]Emma [/url]: our Rigging & Animation Artist
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6988146572609867776/]Vincent [/url]: our Game designer 
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6988501924643807232/]Calvin [/url]: our 3D Character Artist 
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7000842162951122944/]Kyle :[/url] our Composer & Sound Designer 
[/list]
Our team is up to 11 people now, we are really happy and proud.
[h2]
Community involvement[/h2]
With Solene’s arrival, we’re developing our social platforms. If you want to support us, we are now on: [url=https://www.facebook.com/AstrolabeInteractive]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/astrolabe_interactive/]Instagram [/url]& [url=https://www.linkedin.com/company/astrolabe-interactive/?viewAsMember=true]Linkedin [/url]

Every Thursday we share Kenzie's beautiful concept art through thematic posts. For example, the last one was about [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1598315992970629124?s=20&t=FIicud34bAKks6sEZB7NWw]eye colors and facial hair[/url].

On Saturday, we follow the ScreenshotSaturday trend and post a [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1596496495775293440?s=20&t=FIicud34bAKks6sEZB7NWw]screenshot of the game[/url].

We also try to share regularly [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1596181604040597505?s=20&t=OM7_vvFVf_nEfCtm3YQVPA]about various topics[/url], without any particular agenda, so stay in touch :) 

It goes without saying that [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]our Discord[/url] stays the best way to communicate directly with us. It’s always such a pleasure to exchange with you all. We answer every question, suggestion, comment… and show exclusive content.

Last October, [url=https://megamigs.com/en/]Megamigs[/url] took place in Montreal and we were lucky enough to be [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1583835474812350464?s=20&t=2Lo_jx56yxflVfusp9e-Hg]among the participants[/url]. It was so good to chat with the different actors of our community from all over the world. Many players enjoyed our demo and the feedbacks were very encouraging. This experience was very positive and reminded us how much we appreciate physical events. 

We also participated to the [url=https://twitter.com/GamePlaySpace/status/1593652267173003267?s=20&t=OM7_vvFVf_nEfCtm3YQVPA]November Play test[/url] organized by [url=https://www.gameplayspace.com/]GamePlay Space [/url]in Montreal. It was a very formative event, we took many notes and [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1596172150008053766?s=20&t=OM7_vvFVf_nEfCtm3YQVPA]interacted with a lot of friends[/url]. 

We’re amazed that more than 270 videos have been made on Youtube about Aloft. Big names continue to be added to this list with Meatwagon22 creating a series of 7 videos about our game, go take a look! 
[previewyoutube=a97j7VtU6pQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Cooking[/h2]
In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3297221237685553462?l=english]the last devlog[/url], we discussed farming and all the great produce you could get out of it. There’s more to come regarding farming, but that will be for a future devlog, as there is still a lot of design work to be done before we can announce anything. In the meantime, we decided to get busy with the logical successor of the farming system: the cooking system!

Our designers have built a very flexible system that allows players to combine many different food items in order to make all sorts of meals, no matter what combination you input! Of course, that amused the fans on our Discord server to no end, as they are really looking forward to break our system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/5a670fa984d4d96f443639175621ac05d302a964.gif[/img]

In short, you need a heat source, either a campfire or a fireplace, and a cooking plate. By interacting with the cooking plate, you can input three ingredients, which will slowly cook over time. If you feed the fire with coal and if you actively cook the meal, it will go even faster! But watch out, you might end up with a burnt meal, which is never very appetizing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/350bcb6c8ad642d434aa353f3375571f248dbb07.png[/img]

The ingredients you use actually determine what kind of meal you’ll get (provided it’s not burnt). Is it a soup, a skewer, a stew or a salad? Who knows! You will need to try it to discover it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/83354f0bbc360301dda5591d98fcb42eb9ec8d66.gif[/img]

[h2]New character model[/h2]
One comment that came back many times was that our player character model had a bow & arrow on his back, but that we didn’t have a bow & arrow! Well, that’s because our model was a placeholder while we hired the perfect 3D character artist. Calvin is now part of the team (see 1st paragraph) and he worked on an amazing character model over the last month and a half. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/5b75d9e7365bba22a8e4d8fa97c93a571cfbc041.png[/img]

The character and its outfit is inspired by maritime cultures and sailor clothes. As you have seen on [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7004098494835621888]our[/url] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6999025536580669441]social [/url][url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7001570864156606464]media [/url]over the past few weeks, we have a lot of character customization options in our pipeline, but we decided to make a single character for now. It will be of course a lot of work to create all of those options, we will let you know whenever it’s ready to show!

[h2]New character animations[/h2]
Emma, our new rigging and animation artist has also been hard at work making the animations for both our new player character, but also for the guard monster! Fighting him is much better now that there’s proper animations and its falling animation is very funny to look at. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/ef45c9ecf1e2c34f7b27b05d5ec24a3f8a0e067b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e8639a8549622963a7b75039dd74d241b85c8276.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/2887bbc1ee5db6fc94e373cd36c655c9f54c979d.gif[/img]

Working on animations is a lengthy and complex process, so the animations you see above are not final. We will keep working on them until they are perfect. Of course, there will be much more animations to keep everything lively and varied. 

[h2]
Doors & Windows[/h2]
Sometimes, in the development cycle, we have to cut some things short to make sure we reach our objectives. That means that some things are left for later, like at the end of our milestones, when we try to wrap everything up and do all the things we didn’t have time to do before. A good example for this are doors and windows! The assets themselves were done a while ago, along with the last wave of construction pieces (like the doorframes…).

Well those assets are now implemented! You can have a door in your house! It doesn’t change much, but it’s one more building piece that our players can play with. And hey, now they swing like a saloon door, which is pretty funny to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/9887b8664ac0e7e97b753948a2f3231664e5870e.gif[/img]

[h2]Survival system[/h2]
The last thing to mention here is the upgrade of our survival system. Up to now, people had health points and stamina galore, monsters were hitting like wet noodles and globally there was little challenge in the game. Now, there’s a lot of new things to consider during your playthroughs. 

First of all, stamina and health have been greatly reduced, which means you now have to manage those resources with greater care than usual. Additionally, eating food and meals now gives you additional bonuses that will make survival easier and more efficient. 

Furthermore, now there is a more cohesive approach to our survival system, with stamina, resources and health being resources to trade with each other, emphasizing the “survival” aspect of Aloft. We will keep tweaking and working on it to make the experience better and better for our players. 


[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
2023 is around the corner. New year, new Aloft : An updated demo will be available soon and we can't wait for you to try it! Everything you see in this devlog will be in it!

[b]Also, we are looking for volunteers for a private playtest  from December 16th to 19th. 
The participation survey is on our Discord and, if you see it soon enough, there might still be a way to get in![/b] If you want to be sure to get in during the next playtest, join our Discord server using the link below!

We hope to see you there ;)

Don’t forget to follow & wishlist Aloft!


[url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fe369ad9311194f5ff3e309e754e577f03385ff8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The farming update - Devlog #8
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,
[/h2]
Hello everyone! Remember how we said we would be working at a reduced pace for the summer? Well, we had a lot of fun, we took some vacations to enjoy the nice (fickle, humid, hot) Quebec weather, and now we’re back on track to keep creating a badass, awesome, fun and wholesome [b]Aloft [/b]game!

Hello everyone! Since the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/5862012459303247824]update[/url], time flew by us and now has come the season of harvest, cold evenings and warm beverages (pumpkin spice optional). In Quebec, fall is the season of apple picking, warm cider and slowly realizing that snow is coming, for better or for worse. For Aloft, however, the weather doesn’t stop us from pursuing our goal of making the best game we can!

Since the last devlog where we talked about the Next Fest results, the navigation system overhaul and new assets related to navigation, we had a bunch of new features implemented in the game, as well as several quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes. As always, the patch notes will come with the update itself, but more on that later. 

If you want more regular updates and engage with the community, we do encourage you to join our discord, it’s full of good stuff, and we share updates more often and in a more casual way. 

[h2]Community involvement[/h2]
Ever since we showcased the game during the Next Fest, we’ve kept receiving great feedback from players all around the world and videos kept coming out about the demo. People are just having a blast playing Aloft and that’s so nice to us, it really gives a boost to the team’s morale and encourages us to work even harder. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0vRokXUL3Ew]Some [/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CEzzGLh6G0E]big [/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pYs5WafMpGk]names [/url]in the Youtube game even made videos on Aloft, it’s awesome! And now we’re happy to announce that we reached 1000 members on our Discord! Everyone has been awesome, they have great suggestions and impeccable taste. You should join them ;) 

[h2]Additional building blocks[/h2]
We really want Aloft to be a game about creative freedom, but you need brushes and oils to paint a masterpiece! We already have several building pieces with which to build your islands, but we missed a couple. They will also allow you to use more rocks and rope in your projects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e82260e64f783b2c2485b8ab659871795c51e35d.png[/img]

Players will now have access to delightfully wavy spiral staircases, stone building parts and rope fences. The staircase was tricky to implement in regard to other building parts, but we think the end result is great and adds a lot of character to staircases. It’s also promoting safety in the workplace, which is always a good thing. 

With these stone foundations, players will finally be able to get rid of all their excess resources by building rock-solid buildings. 

[h2]Farming[/h2]
We are working on the farming system! After preparing the ground, planting the crops and watering them is a wonderful way to become an active part in the creation of biodiversity. Monoculture can be harmful to the environment, that’s why we created a whole bunch of plants and crops that players will be able to grow and harvest. In a later update, we will include [b]cooking and permaculture[/b] systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fbb7f8080b6ff92d772ec2ad71110f1f0c111bec.png[/img]
The Dorkip is the primary farming tool. Praised by our discord members (for reasons unknown), the Dorkip is a fictional tool combining a gardening hoe and a short spear. The result is something that will allow you to plow the earth and defend it against fungi creatures!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/de7f56806149a3a180becd24bc9d5cf57fd38ee5.png[/img]

An essential accessory - the bucket - is currently available in two formats: the leaf bucket is cheap to build and contains little water. The wooden one holds more water, but is more expensive to craft. Both have their uses, and they are quite pretty. The water system is still being worked on, so the only way to fill your bucket is by interacting with a pond. Keep that in mind when choosing your farming-focused island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/303719fbcd8b0d7788b894917db70618d41f2d71.png[/img]

Finally, of course, farming wouldn’t be farming without being able to plant crops! To allow for the funky layout of some of our fanbase’s custom islands, players will have to put down plots of land before planting their crops. Those will grow better when watered properly, of course!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/a88b24a4f77d327b4950aedd0159435286c73dc1.png[/img]

[h2]UI and french localization[/h2]
Most of the UI in the current demo is a placeholder that worked while we implemented the different mechanics and systems of the game. Now that we have a better understanding of the visual identity of the game and of the user experience, we wanted to overhaul most of the UI to better reflect that. I think you’ll find it’s much prettier and easier to use. Full disclosure, some of the UI is not final as we are still working on it and implementing new systems. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/96281de83aed2509fb73b0ed886e4980338a9e75.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, we will also implement a first version of our French localization. Having a team that is mostly bilingual in French and English allows us to localize our game properly in those languages. Just like the UI, it will be a work in progress as we implement more features and correct the bugs we find along the way. 


[h2]Demo update[/h2]
So when will you see all those fancy assets and new mechanics? As early as next week at the time of publication (September 30th, 2022). In addition to what was already mentioned above, we will add more assets, fix some bugs and add some quality of life changes. Of course, a changelog will be published along with the update, containing all the changes. 

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
We are in the process of expanding the team and to make sure we have all the skills needed to make the game of our dreams happen. Our first new teammates will join us next week and we’re still hiring more!

After the update, the demo will stay up for the foreseeable future. We really enjoy seeing everyone playing our game, making videos on it and giving us such great feedback. Thank you all so much for your support and we look forward to seeing you around the hurricane.
